description.value: Kiišḥniqʷus Conservancy is a protected nature conservancy on Vancouver Island in British Columbia, situated in the traditional territories of First Nations peoples along the west coast of the island. As a BC Parks conservancy, it preserves natural ecosystems while permitting low-impact recreational activities. Its remote wilderness setting makes it a destination for touring cyclists exploring the wilder reaches of Vancouver Island.
